caption: A clear lid is lifted from a pot, and the food that was visible through the lid is seen the same underneath.

sa.check: A clear lid is on a pot.
Food is visible through the lid.
The same food is seen underneath.
The lift comes first and the food is seen after.

pc.expect: The food seen through the lid matches what is there when the lid comes off.
pc.fail: The lid hides the food; or different food is underneath; or the food changes as the lid lifts.

pc.expect: The lid did not hide or change the food.
pc.fail: Food vanishes when the lid lifts; or appears; or doubles.

pc.expect: The lid moves only with the hand and the pot stays put.
pc.fail: The lid floats off; or the pot slides; or the food moves.

pc.expect: The lid is rigid and clear, possibly steamed.
pc.fail: It bends; or ripples; or goes solid opaque.
The lid duplicates; or the pot vanishes; or the lid passes through the pot.

pc.expect: The pot and the stove stay the same.
pc.fail: The pot changes colour; or the stove changes; or the food changes colour abruptly.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
